newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan rises on restructuring report.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan rises on restructuring report.

text.p: Shares in supermarket operator Yaohan Japan Corp rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on Monday morning following a newspaper report over the weekend about further restructuring plans.
By 0154 GMT, Yaohan shares were up 40 yen at 530.
Yaohan Japan, the Yaohan group's flagship firm, will sell about 10 outlets in Japan, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Saturday.
Using these funds and money from sales of other assets, including securities and land, Yaohan plans to halve its debts within two years, the paper said.
Tokai Bank Ltd, which has close business ties with Yaohan, is expected to accept the restructuring plan, the newspaper said.
Yaohan Japan was not immediately available for comment on the report.
